summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season with several new signings and a returning player bolstering the squad ahead of their campaign kick-off next week. The Ramblers have been active in pre-season, recently facing St Helens in a competitive friendly where they were narrowly beaten despite a solid performance. With three new kits in place and sponsorship opportunities available, the club is ready to push for promotion this season.
